title: Ladybug with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Body/head base - deep lit purple-blue -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="34" ry="30" fill="#3a3a8c"/>
  
  <!-- Red wing covers -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="31" ry="26" fill="#e83030"/>
  
  <!-- Wing divider line -->
  <line x1="50" y1="35" x2="50" y2="85" stroke="#aa1010" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Wing highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="50" rx="8" ry="12" fill="#ff6060" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Black spots (deep purple-blue, lit) -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="52" r="5" fill="#2a2a6a"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="52" r="5" fill="#2a2a6a"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="72" r="4.5" fill="#2a2a6a"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="72" r="4.5" fill="#2a2a6a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="4" fill="#2a2a6a"/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="32" r="16" fill="#2a2a6a"/>
  
  <!-- Antennae -->
  <line x1="42" y1="20" x2="34" y2="8" stroke="#5a5ab0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="7" r="3" fill="#ffcc00"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="20" x2="66" y2="8" stroke="#5a5ab0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="7" r="3" fill="#ffcc00"/>
  
  <!-- Eyes - white sparkly -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="30" r="5.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="30" r="5.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- Pupils -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="30" r="3" fill="#2a2a6a"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="30" r="3" fill="#2a2a6a"/>
  
  <!-- Sparkle highlights in eyes -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="28.5" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="28.5" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="31.5" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="31.5" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- Tiny 4-point sparkle stars around eyes -->
  <path d="M36 26 L37 23 L38 26 L41 27 L38 28 L37 31 L36 28 L33 27 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
  <path d="M64 26 L65 23 L66 26 L69 27 L66 28 L65 31 L64 28 L61 27 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M44 38 Q50 44 56 38" stroke="#ffcc00" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="37" r="3" fill="#ff7070" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="37" r="3" fill="#ff7070" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Legs -->
  <line x1="22" y1="55" x2="12" y2="50" stroke="#5a5ab0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="65" x2="10" y2="65" stroke="#5a5ab0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="22" y1="75" x2="12" y2="82" stroke="#5a5ab0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="78" y1="55" x2="88" y2="50" stroke="#5a5ab0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="65" x2="90" y2="65" stroke="#5a5ab0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="78" y1="75" x2="88" y2="82" stroke="#5a5ab0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
